---
title: Release procedure
---

## Modus operandi
The release procedure for Wflow is currently in the process of automation. Nevertheless, the manual steps (internal procedure) associated with releasing are listed here:
* Prerequisite: continuous integration checks and builds all successful, both on GitHub Actions as well as [TeamCity](https://dpcbuild.deltares.nl/project/wflow)
* A commit and push on the repository to mark te version
* Tag new patch release on commit message (@JuliaRegistrator register subdir=Wflow)
* The release registration takes approx. 15 minutes
* TeamCity builds should complete
* Signing of resulting binaries should complete ([separate signing project producing signed binaries](https://dpcbuild.deltares.nl/project/SigningAndCertificates_SigningWflow?mode=buildsn))
* Manually test the signed binaries <br>
* The signed binaries should be uploaded to the P-drive under
`p:\1000365-002-wflow\binaries\wflow_cli\`
* Update the download portal with the location of the new binaries on the P-drive (notify DTC support department).
* Notify the Wflow Teams chat of the new version


## Overview of CI configurations on TeamCity
All TeamCity configurations regarding Wflow, except for the signing of Wflow binaries is found under the [`Wflow`]([`Wflow`](https://dpcbuild.deltares.nl/project/wflow)) project, which has the following configurations:
* Build Docker
* Build MSIX package
* Linux
    * Build `wflow-cli`
    * Test `wflow-cli`
* Windows
    * Build `wflow-cli`
    * Test `wflow-cli`
